subject.title: fix(discord): preserve content-type and skip optimization for animated/WebP images

question: Should this Discord media fix expose preserveWebp/preserveAvif as public plugin SDK options and intentionally fail oversized preserved WebP/AVIF/APNG media instead of recompressing it?
rationale: The remaining blockers are public API and user-visible delivery contracts: preserving animation fixes silent data loss, but public SDK flags and fail-closed cap behavior affect plugin callers and existing Discord sends in ways automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Refresh and narrow the contract
options.body: Rebase or replace the branch on current main, keep preservation policy owner-local unless explicitly approved, and add live Discord proof.

options.title: Approve the new media contract
options.body: Accept the public preserve options and fail-closed oversized-media behavior, then document and prove that behavior before merge.

options.title: Replace the branch
options.body: Keep the linked issue open and use a fresh narrow PR if the stale dirty branch is too costly to repair.

recommendation.title: Refresh and narrow the contract
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the branch on current main, keep preservation policy owner-local unless explicitly approved, and add live Discord proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest sampled history across the Discord send and shared web-media surfaces involved in this contract choice.
